description: Search Staylonger extended-stay rental properties in Australia by location, dates, guest count, bedrooms and one feature such as pet-friendly or on-site parking. Returns up to 10 matching listings with pricing, the property id for the other tools, and a link to each property page.

features.description: Only listings with this feature. One at a time for now. family-friendly: Family-friendly; pet-friendly: Pet-friendly; parking: On-site parking; ev-charging: EV charging; workspace: Dedicated workspace; outdoor-space: Balcony, patio or garden; pool: Pool; gym: Gym.

location.description: Suburb, city or postcode to search near, e.g. 'Bondi Beach' or 'Melbourne'.

name: search_properties

location.description: The place the search resolved to.

dailyPrice.description: Guide nightly price, when the listing has one.

fromPrice30Nights.description: All-inclusive total for the next available 30-night stay.

id.description: The property id the other tools take.

priceNote.description: Present when the listing has no guide price.

stayEstimate.description: Dated search only: the stay's estimated total with the guest fee.

title: Search properties
